title: 第6章 公门好修行
content_zh:
‘丁守成’被四方武馆革除之事在孟惟的推动下，天黑之前就让松阳县的中高层人员都知道了。

    理由是品行不端且贪得无厌，不服管教还忤逆师长。

    但是却没有说具体原因，毕竟孟惟也不傻，真把真实情况说出来他也不讨好。

    所以还是含糊其辞的比较好，而且在他看来这些理由不是重点。

    重点是他下了悬赏。

    有人要是能废了‘丁守成’的武功，四方武馆就给一百两纹银作为赏赐。

    这可是一百两纹银，动手的人压根就不会在意什么理由。

    只是很快，作为铜章捕头的田牧川就出手了。

    直接把魏乐府说的情况传播了出去，就孟惟这理由，完全能够和要钱、想要讨媳妇两件事对上了。

    简直是对号入座，再加上孟惟只给理由没说为什么，正好被魏乐府的‘实情’给填补了这方面的空白。

    在魏乐府先入为主的优势下，孟惟真就黄泥掉裤裆，不是屎也是屎了。

    主要是太巧了，更重要的是魏乐府速度更快。

    所以就变成了孟惟的理由补充了魏乐府的‘真话’。

    至于说四方武馆否认了？那你总得说是什么原因吧。

    这也不说那也不说的，大家又不是傻子，特别是远威武馆得知这件事后第一时间进行煽风点火。

    被算计了的孟惟自然是气得不轻，但却也没辙了。

    因为等孟惟确定魏乐府的行踪时就已经晚了。

    魏乐府成了六扇门铁尺捕快，成了朝廷鹰犬。

    他还真不敢做些什么，甚至连带着悬赏也只能灰溜溜的撤了。

    靠着本地的关系去搞魏乐府？真把松阳县当成四方武馆的地盘不成？

    他能疏通关系，远威武馆也可以呀。

    只要魏乐府当一天铁尺捕快，四方武馆就多一个敌人并且被持续恶心。

    这对于远威武馆来说是非常值得的支出。

    更别说魏乐府的顶头上司是田牧川这位铜章捕头，哪怕是县令都得敬三分的实权人物。

    -----------------
content_en:
The fact that 'Ding Shoucheng' was expelled from Sifang Martial Arts Hall was pushed by Meng Wei, and all the middle and high-level personnel in Songyang County knew about it before dark.

    The reason is that he has bad conduct and is greedy. He refuses to obey discipline and is disobedient to his teacher.

    But he didn't say the specific reason. After all, Meng Wei was not stupid, and he wouldn't be pleased if he told the truth.

    So it's better to be vague, and in his opinion, these reasons are not the focus.

    The point is that he placed a reward.

    If anyone can defeat 'Ding Shoucheng's' martial arts, Sifang Martial Arts Hall will reward him with one hundred taels of silver.

    This is a hundred taels of silver, and the person who does it doesn't care about the reason at all.

    But soon, Tian Muchuan, who was the Bronze Badge's head catcher, took action.

    Directly spreading the situation that Wei Yuefu said, Meng Wei's reason can completely match the two things of asking for money and wanting a wife.

    It was a perfect fit, and since Meng Wei only gave reasons but not why, Wei Yuefu's 'truth' filled the gap in this regard.

    With the advantage of Wei Yuefu's preconception, Meng Weizhen fell down with yellow mud, which was either shit or shit.

    Mainly because it was a coincidence, but more importantly, Wei Yuefu was faster.

    So it became Meng Wei's reasons that supplemented Wei Yuefu's 'truth'.

    As for Sifang Martial Arts School denying it? Then you have to tell me what the reason is.

    Don't say this or that, everyone is not a fool, especially Yuanwei Martial Arts Hall, who immediately started to stir up trouble after learning about this incident.

    Meng Wei, who had been tricked, was naturally very angry, but there was nothing he could do about it.

    Because by the time Meng Wei confirmed Wei Yuefu's whereabouts, it was already too late.

    Wei Yuefu became a six-door iron ruler to catch the fast, and became the court's eagle dog.

    He really didn't dare to do anything, even with the reward on his head, he could only withdraw in despair.

    Relying on local connections to get Wei Yuefu? Do you really regard Songyang County as the territory of Sifang Martial Arts School?

    He can smoothen the relationship, even if he is far away from the martial arts hall.

    As long as Wei Yuefu acts as an iron ruler for a day, Sifang Martial Arts Hall will have one more enemy and will continue to be disgusted.

    This is a very worthwhile expenditure for Yuanwei Martial Arts Hall.

    Not to mention that Wei Yuefu's immediate boss is Tian Muchuan, a bronze-badged arrester, a powerful figure who even the county magistrate must respect.

    ------------------
